例如 example.com，回车添加: e.g. example.com, press Enter to add
表单之外单独使用的选择控件，都是受控的 value + onChange。在 r: Picker controls used on their own, outside forms, all controlled with value + onChange. In a react-hook-form form use the matching FormMultiSelect / FormTags / FormDate / FormDateTime / FormTreeSelect (see the Forms page). There is no date range component: combine two DatePickers. TreeSelect picks a single node; for picking several tree nodes use CheckableTree.
可搜索的多选，值是数组并保留选项值的类型；maxShown 控制显示几个标签，其: A searchable multi-select; the value is an array that keeps the option values' type, and maxShown sets how many badges show before the rest collapse into +N.
回车或逗号添加，退格删除最后一个，自动去重；需要统一大小写等处理时在 onCha: Enter or a comma adds a tag, Backspace removes the last one, and duplicates are dropped; normalize (e.g. the case) in onChange.
值是 'YYYY-MM-DD' 字符串，空为 ''，可以直接传给接口；clear: The value is a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string, '' when empty, ready to send to the API; clearable={false} for values that must be set.
两个 DatePicker 组成范围，改一端时保证开始不晚于结束；任一端可以为空: Two DatePickers make a range; changing one end keeps the start no later than the end, and either end can be empty for no bound.
传入接口的 UTC 时间，按浏览器时区显示和编辑，onChange 给出带时区偏: Pass the API's UTC time; it is shown and edited in the browser's time zone, and onChange gives ISO 8601 with the offset.
单选树节点，可按名称或编码搜索；excludeId 在编辑时排除自己和子孙，no: Picks one tree node, searchable by name or code; excludeId leaves out the node being edited and its descendants, noneLabel allows an empty pick, and disabled nodes can't be picked.
选中的值（受控），V 为 string 或 number: The selected values (controlled); V is string or number
勾选或移除时调用，传入新的数组: Called when an option is checked or removed, with the new array
选项 { label, value }，label 为中文原文: Options { label, value }; label is Chinese source text
最多显示几个标签，其余折叠成 +N: How many badges show before the rest collapse into +N
添加或删除时调用；添加时按逗号拆分、去掉首尾空格并去重: Called on add or remove; added text is split on commas, trimmed and deduplicated
'YYYY-MM-DD'（更长的字符串取前 10 位）；'' / null 为空: 'YYYY-MM-DD' (a longer string is cut to its first 10 characters); '' / null is empty
有值时显示清空按钮: Shows a clear button when there is a value
接口时间（ISO 8601，例如 UTC 的 …Z）；'' / null 为空: An API time (ISO 8601, e.g. UTC …Z); '' / null is empty
传入带浏览器时区偏移的 ISO 8601（接口转成 UTC），清空时为 '': Gets ISO 8601 with the browser's offset (the API converts it to UTC), or '' when cleared
选中节点的 id（受控）；null / '' 为未选: The picked node's id (controlled); null / '' means none
选中或清空时调用: Called when a node is picked or cleared
节点树，见下方 TreeSelectNode: The node tree, see TreeSelectNode below
隐藏该节点和它的子孙，例如编辑时选上级，避免循环: Hides this node and its descendants, e.g. when picking a new parent while editing, to prevent cycles
设置后第一项可以选空（null）: When set, the first option picks null
显示在名称旁、也参与搜索的节点字段: The node field shown next to the name and matched by the search
触发按钮的 class；其余属性（id / aria-*）传给触发按钮: Class of the trigger button; other props (id / aria-*) go to the trigger button
显示的名称（数据，不翻译）；触发按钮显示完整路径: The name shown (data, not translated); the trigger shows the full path
编码，显示在名称旁并参与搜索: Code, shown next to the name and matched by the search
未选时的文字（中文原文，组件内翻译）: Text shown when nothing is selected (Chinese source text, translated by the component)
没有标签时的占位文字: Placeholder while there are no tags
未选时的文字: Text shown when nothing is selected
搜索无结果时的文字: Text shown when the search finds nothing
